# Summer Picnic Menu for 10

A no-cook, nut-free picnic set that travels well and uses easy supermarket ingredients. I’ve chosen items that hold up safely, taste good chilled or at room temperature, and can be made mostly ahead.

# No-Cook Picnic Dish Set

## 1) Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Why it works:** sturdy, filling, and better after chilling.
- **Main ingredients:** canned chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, feta, parsley, lemon, olive oil.
- **Travel tip:** pack dressing separately if you want maximum crunch.

**Make-ahead:** up to **2 days ahead**
**Best served:** chilled or cool

## 2) Turkey, Cheese, and Crunchy Veggie Wraps
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- **Why it works:** neat to pack, easy to eat by hand, and not messy if tightly wrapped.
- **Main ingredients:** large tortillas, sliced turkey, cheddar or Swiss, lettuce, cucumber, shredded carrots, hummus or cream cheese.
- **Travel tip:** wrap each one in parchment and keep whole until serving.

**Make-ahead:** up to **1 day ahead**
**Best served:** chilled or room temperature

## 3) Berry Yogurt Parfaits in Jars
- **Why it works:** light dessert that stays picnic-friendly in sealed containers.
- **Main ingredients:** Greek yogurt, strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, granola, honey.
- **Travel tip:** keep granola separate until serving so it stays crisp.

**Make-ahead:** up to **1 day ahead**
**Best served:** chilled

## 4) Lemon Mint Sparkling Cooler
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Why it works:** refreshing, simple, and easy to transport in a sealed pitcher or bottles.
- **Main ingredients:** sparkling water, lemon juice, mint, a little sugar or honey, ice.
- **Travel tip:** mix everything except ice ahead of time; add ice at the picnic.

**Make-ahead:** base up to **2 days ahead**
**Best served:** very cold

# Make-Ahead Timing and Packing Plan

| Item | How far ahead | Packing method | Best serving note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mediterranean Chickpea Salad | 2 days | Airtight container; dressing separate if preferred | Chill before serving |
| Turkey, Cheese, and Crunchy Veggie Wraps | 1 day | Wrap individually in parchment, then place in a container | Keep cold until eating |
| Berry Yogurt Parfaits | 1 day | Jar or lidded cup; granola in a separate bag | Add granola at serving |
| Lemon Mint Sparkling Cooler | 2 days for base | Bottle or sealed pitcher; ice separate | Add ice just before serving |

# Packing Checklist for 10 People

- 10 plates or compostable plates
- 10 forks and 10 napkins
- 1 large serving spoon for salad
- 1 small tongs or extra spoon for wraps, if sliced
- 10 jars or cups with lids for parfaits
- 1 insulated cooler or picnic bag
- Ice packs or ice
- 2–3 airtight containers for salads and wrap components
- Parchment paper or foil for wrapping sandwiches
- 1 cutting board and 1 knife for final slicing if needed
- Serving bowl for chickpea salad
- Pitcher or sealed bottles for the drink
- Trash bag and wet wipes
- Hand sanitizer

# Quick Prep Notes

- **Nut-free check:** choose granola labeled nut-free, and verify hummus, tortillas, and deli meat labels for cross-contact if needed.
- **Food safety:** keep dairy and meat items cold in a cooler until serving.
- **Easy supermarket shopping:** all ingredients are common grocery items and can be bought pre-washed or pre-cut to save time.

# Sources

- USDA food safety basics: https://www.fsis.usda.gov/food-safety
- FDA food storage guidance: https://www.fda.gov/food/buy-store-serve-safe-food/food-safety-when-eating-outdoors
- Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics picnic safety tips: https://www.eatright.org/food/planning-and-prep/cooking-tips-and-trends/picnic-food-safety
